# CLAIM_AUDIT (Phase 3)

Independent re-check of each load-bearing bridge premise against the primary text recorded in EVIDENCE_LEDGER.md. Statuses: SUPPORTED / PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED / CONTESTED / UNSUPPORTED / MISATTRIBUTED / INFERENCE_ONLY. Claims marked UNSUPPORTED or INFERENCE_ONLY are not used as factual premises below; they appear only as hypotheses.
